high_level_description: This image captures a person taking a selfie in an outdoor setting. The individual is holding a white water bottle in their left hand and appears to be wearing a black shirt with a light blue sleeve rolled up on the right arm. They have a colorful crossbody bag with a geometric pattern over their shoulder. The background features a scenic landscape with a sign that reads "Slide Rock Market." The market sign includes illustrations of apples and a green oval border. The setting is a grassy area with some patches of dirt, surrounded by trees and a mountain range in the distance.
